The use of `sed` to update the version in Cargo.toml is a standard technique in AUR packages for Rust projects and does not introduce risk. Optional dependencies are clearly declared and relate directly to the GUI functionality of the application. Desktop and icon files are installed in appropriate locations. All actions are confined to the build and package directories, with no evidence of data exfiltration, remote code execution, or system-wide changes beyond what is expected for this type of package.
